polyzoa.definition:
n marine or freshwater animals that form colonies of zooids
n sessile aquatic animal forming mossy colonies of small polyps each having a curved or circular ridge bearing tentacles; attach to stones or seaweed and reproduce by budding

polyzoan.definition: n sessile aquatic animal forming mossy colonies of small polyps each having a curved or circular ridge bearing tentacles; attach to stones or seaweed and reproduce by budding

polyzoarium.translation: n. 苔藓虫的群体(或其骨骼)

polyzonal.definition: a. Consisting of many zones or rings.
polyzonal.translation: a. 多区域的, 多环带的, 多圈的
